issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires Farm to hold its animals in a List and to initialize an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor, but the reference solution implements the animals collection as a Set (HashSet) and exposes/accepts a Set in its getter/setter. This is a structural mismatch: List vs Set changes semantics (ordering, duplicates) and may confuse students or cause tests that expect List/ArrayList behavior to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Farm implementation match the specification: change the animals attribute type in the solution to List<Animal>, initialize it with new ArrayList<>() in the no-arg constructor, and update the getter/setter signatures to use List<Animal>. Alternatively, if Set semantics are intended, update the problem statement and UML to explicitly state a Set/HashSet is required and explain the different behavior regarding ordering and duplicates.
